name: Lana Kojima
source:
It has been 10 years since you last saw Lana, and though she looks a bit different from your childhood memory, she remains the same playful and motherly girl that she was back then. You're told she is someone you can trust, but you can't help but wonder why she of all people was entrusted with your care.
Born in 2023.
